notes: Side-by-side illustration (bim_bridge_pm_comparison_v0); not a benchmark and not evidence of generalisation.

Source: CubiCasa5K v4 high_quality/4712 (F1_scaled.png). CubiCasa5K v4 (public dataset), test split of the upstream Phase 5 run; the model never trained on these plans. Ground truth: the dataset's SVG-derived masks as generated by the upstream target pipeline.

Source render: none: the saved prediction was made from this file by the upstream evaluate stage (/home/pmharris/dev/cubicasa5k_data/data/datasets/qmarva/cubicasa5k/versions/4/cubicasa5k/cubicasa5k/high_quality/4712/F1_scaled.png, sha256 8c00e3cabbaa476284812c2ed38ade3ad443a4d6d16c402b9f9d8b0ebeb95243); decided before inference, see source_render_decision.json. The source_image hash is that of the original archive member.
Saved upstream Phase 5 prediction of a held-out TEST plan, read in place; thresholds were selected on the validation split. No inference was run by this experiment.

Inference record: /mnt/e/AI_Team/mitunet/experiments/bim_bridge_pm_comparison_v0/bim_bridge_pm_comparison_v0_20261006_130747_UTC/samples/cc-01/inference/cc-01__inference_record.json. No probability maps exist for this plan.
No label, annotation or ground-truth file was read to construct this geometry. Independence from the training data is UNKNOWN unless the subset manifest states otherwise.

The upstream structural_wall head predicts walls with openings NOT subtracted, so a wall runs through its doors and windows; the door_opening, window_opening head(s) propose the apertures, each exported with the vertical profile that preview profile 'pilot_preview_profile_v1' gives its class.
No geometry, repair, scale or review decision of CubiCasa sample 333 is used.
Vectorizer walls excluded from export (recorded in candidate_geometry.json excluded_walls): none.
Predicted opening components not exported (recorded in candidate_geometry.json openings_not_exported): 1.

scale.note: ARBITRARY VISUALIZATION SCALE. No verified plan scale exists for this source. 1 original raster pixel is drawn as 0.01 preview metres so the model has a viewable size. This is not a measurement and not a claim about the dataset or the building. Metric export stays BLOCKED.

evidence.description: Pilot preview profile 'pilot_preview_profile_v1' from the experiment instructions: 1 ORIGINAL raster pixel = 0.01 preview metres. Not derived from the drawing.
evidence.derived_by: Visualization default proposed in the experiment instructions; applied by the adapter. It is not a human confirmation of a real scale.
evidence.uncertainty_note: Unbounded. The true scale of the drawing is unknown; pixel dimensions, DPI and typical door widths do not establish it.

derivation.applied: once, after the source-to-letterbox transform: metres_per_candidate_px = metres_per_original_px / letterbox_scale

selection.rule: whole-plan attempt: every vectorizer wall whose automated diagnostics pass; nothing selected by hand

continuous_wall_evidence_omitted_by_vect.legend: dark red = predicted wall, bright = skeleton; green channel = skeleton not within the junction tolerance of any candidate body

non_orthogonal_raw_lines.note: The vectorizer snaps every line to horizontal or vertical (orthogonal_only). Raw Hough lines further than the angle tolerance from both axes indicate diagonal or curved wall evidence that straight orthogonal candidates cannot represent.

plan_diagnostics.curved_or_unsupported_geometry: Only straight, constant-thickness walls are supported. Curved walls are not detected as such; they appear as uncovered skeleton runs, off-axis raw lines, or excluded walls with low axis support.
